messages:
Rae (People Ops): Quick note  cohort of 4 tomorrow. Two onsite, two remote. Onsite I-9 window 8:30-10:00. Who can staff the verification table and escort from lobby? :wave:
Tom (Facilities): I can do 8:25-9:15. Need names and license plates by EOD so I can prep visitor passes.
Yuki (IT): Ill cover 9:15-10:00 and drop laptops at front desk by 8:00. Image tag: ONB-APR-26. Will include Wi-Fi sticker `onboard_guest` and manager buddy contact.
Rae (People Ops): Heads-up: Ali (one of the hires) is an international candidate; his EAD card is active but his passport is expiring and vendor flagged as "document mismatch". He uploaded EAD and visa stamp, vendor still needs a second ID.
Ali (New Hire): I can bring my state driver's license and the printed EAD. Im currently in the U.S. so EAD + DL should be fine for I-9?
HR-Bot: Reminder: List of acceptable documents here: https://www.uscis.gov/i-9/list-of-acceptable-documents. EAD (List A) alone is sufficient for I-9. If using combinations, employer must examine in-person. For remote options, NotaryNow accepts EAD.
Rae (People Ops): Can we do the I-9 in person then? Also need to confirm whether we can badge him same day: front desk policy requires HR verification or preapproved courier.
Tom (Facilities): If I complete the verification and sign the form, we can issue a temp badge and escort him. Ill send the plate pass to frontdesk@redwood.
Legal-Jen: Confirming: EAD (List A) is acceptable by itself to complete Form I-9. If vendor shows mismatch because passport is expiring, accept the EAD + employer must copy acceptable docs to secure file. For international hires, ensure E-Verify status if applicable.
Rae (People Ops): Thanks Jen. Ali, please bring original EAD + a secondary photo ID if possible. Also upload scans to the onboarding portal so compliance has records.
Samir (Hiring Manager): Ill meet Ali in lobby at 8:20 and join the verification. Also want to run a 15-min team intro at 10:15 in the conference room (calendar invite sent).
Yuki (IT): Quick note on provisioning: temp credentials will be `alias_temp` until HR confirms completed I-9. We'll rotate and deprovision if docs not completed within 72 hours.
Ali (New Hire): Uploaded EAD scan and DL this morning and emailed compliance@redwood.com. Thanks for the clear plan.
Rae (People Ops): Couriers  badge envelopes: if I-9 done, Tom will put printed badge in envelope and front desk will hand it after verification. If anything blocks I-9, we will courier a temp badge next-day with express shipping (cost center PEOPLE-ONB).
Tom (Facilities): Note for logistics: parking lot B is tight tomorrow; recommend carpool or use visitor drop-off by the plaza. Ill reserve two spots in Lot C for the cohort (submit request here: https://intranet.redwood/parking/request).
Legal-Jen: Also a small compliance reminder: retain copies of ID docs in the secure onboarding S3 bucket and log the reviewer name + date. Rae, please ensure upload.
Rae (People Ops): Action items: (1) Tom to submit passes + escort (2) Yuki confirm laptop images staged by 8:00 (3) Ali bring originals + upload scans (4) Rae to confirm badge envelope workflow and courier contingency (5) Samir to attend lobby meet.
Samir (Hiring Manager): Approved $45 for light breakfast (coffee + pastries) for onsite. Tom, can you pick up at 7:45?
Tom (Facilities): Yep, will grab and leave at front desk with labels.
Rae (People Ops): Final: I'll add Ali to the 10:15 team intro Zoom in case he needs to join remotely for any portion. Ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:
